estimated_governance_tokens.label: estimated
estimated_governance_tokens.method: A static estimate, not read from a session log. instruction_files: for each session named for the ticket, the tokens (4 characters a token, rounded up) of the file of its role, .claude/agents/<role>.md, and of CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md at the project's root where they exist, summed over the sessions; the caller names each session's role, and the instruction files of a sub-agent are not counted. mcp_definitions: 0 by decision, with its reason beside it; no file is read for it.
estimated_governance_tokens.mcp_definitions_reason: the Governance OS defines no MCP server (DEC-507): whatever the project defines is not governance text

not_measured.reason: an attachment line of a type the specimens do not show

known_gaps.name: precompact_hook_output
known_gaps.reason: the output of a PreCompact hook is in no hook line of the log: nothing is counted for it

known_gaps.name: gov_run_indirectly
known_gaps.reason: a gov command inside bash -c, eval, backticks or a wrapper script is not seen: its result is not counted

known_gaps.name: subagent_instruction_files
known_gaps.reason: the instruction files a sub-agent of a named session was given are not part of the estimate: they are not counted
